title: C¹ segment estimate |v(x) − v(y)| ≤ ‖x − y‖ ∫₀¹ ‖Dv((1 − t)y + tx)‖ dt
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), v : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 v), and x, y ∈ ℝⁿ. Then |v(x) − v(y)| ≤ ‖x − y‖ · ∫_0^1 ‖Dv((1 − t)y + tx)‖ dt, where Dv(z) = fderiv ℝ v z with the operator norm and the integral is the interval integral from 0 to 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Euclid n → ℝ) (x y : Euclid n), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → |v x - v y| ≤ ‖x - y‖ * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖fderiv ℝ v ((1 - t) • y + t • x)‖
